Funding detail: Full financial support (stipend) provided. Amount not specified.

About the Position

  • Institution: University of Manitoba Price Faculty of Engineering
  • Department: Department of Civil Engineering
  • Positions: Two (2) M.Sc. and Two (2) Ph.D. positions
  • Start Date: Fall 2026 or Winter 2027

About the Research

Successful applicants will work on one or more of the following research areas:

  1. Advanced Computer Vision for Structural Health Monitoring (SHM)
  2. Digital Twins and 3D Reconstruction
  3. Advanced Deep Learning for Damage Assessment
  4. Advanced Autonomous Robotic Systems (UAVs and UGVs)

Candidate Requirements

  • General: Strong academic record high motivation for research excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • International Applicants: Must meet the University of Manitoba's English-language proficiency requirements (e.g. TOEFL IELTS). An official test score must be included in the initial application email to the professor.

Financial Support

  • Admitted students will receive financial support (stipend).
  • Students may apply for scholarships and teaching assistant (TA) positions to supplement funding.

Application Process

  • Initial Application: Email the following documents to young.cha@umanitoba.ca:
  1. Detailed curriculum vitae (CV)
  2. Copies of all academic transcripts
  3. Official English-language proficiency test score (if applicable)
  • Shortlisted: Candidates will be invited for an online interview.
  • Formal Application: After a successful interview candidates will be encouraged to submit a formal application to the University of Manitoba's graduate program within one month of the letter date.

Professor Profile

  • Name: YoungJin Cha Ph.D. P.Eng. HCR F.ASCE
  • Title: Professor
  • Office: SP-427 EITC 15 Gillson Street Winnipeg Manitoba R3T 5V6 Canada
  • Editorial Roles: Editor for TII IEEE EAAI Elsevier SHM SAGE SCHM Wiley ER Wiley
  • Research Web: University of Manitoba Research Page

Official Link

https://www.umanitoba.ca/research/

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 3 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
